headline: Magnus Steel and Infra announces details of Rs 39.89 crore rights issue
hook: Smallcap steel company raises fresh capital
summary: Magnus Steel and Infra Limited has released the detailed terms for its proposed rights issue worth Rs 39.89 crore. Rights issues allow existing shareholders to purchase additional shares at a discount to the market price, based on their current holdings. This corporate action alters the company's equity capital structure and share dilution levels. Retail investors holding the stock must evaluate whether to subscribe to the issue or let their rights lapse.
whats_next: Record date for the rights issue to be announced
why_it_matters: Your existing shareholding in the company gets diluted
